descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT OAT-06 test 3; TFA-94514 req 1 · “Duplicate prompt → shown / accepted / rejected all logged”. Mixed: stated part — Manual-add duplicate prompt shown + accepted / rejected in both contexts; our part — Shared promptId, never both outcomes, no names or room in rows (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Approach · OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · S05 Duplicate prompt on manual add: context x choice -> which rows

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 A duplicate-detection prompt logs that it was shown, and logs whether the physician accepted or rejected it (manual add and scan, both contexts) (UAT OAT-06 Test 3; UAT 3.3; TFA-94514 AC 1; TFA-92580 AC 7; TFA-92580 AC 5)
  • U1 Adding a patient by scan and by manual entry is logged, each add tagged by method (scan vs manual), in Hospital and in Nursing Home (UAT OAT-06 Test 1; UAT 3.3; TFA-94514 AC 1; TFA-92580 AC 7; TFA-92580 Analytics)
  • U15 Usage analytics rows carry no patient content (no name, MRN, room, diagnosis, task text or note text), so rows that outlive a deleted patient do not break the 36 h retention claim or TC-24's hard del … (UAT 3.6; UAT TC-24)

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given Fresh physician with one Hospital patient 'QA Hosp OAT06 Dup' (room 4B-62) and one Nursing Home resident 'QA Resident OAT06 Dup'; T0 recorded

When R1 Hospital manual re-add, answer Cancel; R2 Hospital manual re-add, answer OK; R3 Nursing Home manual re-add, Cancel; R4 Nursing Home manual re-add, OK

Then R1: shown + accepted (hospital, manual), no new patient_added. R2: shown + rejected (hospital, manual), patient_added manual +1, two charts with the name. R3: shown + accepted (nursing_home, manual). R4: shown + rejected + patient_added nursing_home manual. Every outcome row shares its prompt's promptId and no prompt has both accepted and rejected. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT OAT-06 Test 3 'shown / accepted / rejected all logged'. Post-run read: per row the exact events above. The meaning of accepted vs rejected is Q5; the run records the mapping and judges only that each prompt has one shown row and exactly one outcome row. U15: serialised rows mustNotContain 'QA Hosp OAT06 Dup', 'QA Resident OAT06 Dup', '4B-62', 'Pneumonia'. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S05 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-06.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.
